violation_type.title: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License (26 TAC §746.901(10))
violation_type.short_title: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License
violation_type.typical_finding: The caregivers have not signed statements saying they have received orientation.

finding_variants.text: The caregivers have not signed statements saying they have received orientation.
One listed directors record did not contain a drivers license.     One listed directors record contained an expired drivers license.
Four employees did not have on file documentation of receiving orientation.
Out of 10 staff files reviewed 6 were missing documentation of completing orientation.
Two of six personnel records did not have the required abuse/neglect training.
Four of six staff files were missing signed statement verifying the date of orientation training.
